fields.acceptance: A test in internal/tui builds the inbox app over a fake inbox result with one item of each kind and asserts the view groups them under kind headings with each row's change set, step and question or detail, shows a recommendation where present, and shows Nothing waits on you for an empty inbox; a tick message reloads it; the app appears in the launcher's registry and the Rex install script; a testscript checks --once against rhiza inbox --json
fields.statement: An inbox app, registered as a Rex app like the others, lists the items of rhiza inbox as a cursor list grouped by kind (questions, sign-offs, failed runs, gave-up and skipped), each row with its change set's title, step and what it asks or why it failed, and a question's advisor recommendation when it has one; it reloads every few seconds and on r, says Nothing waits on you when empty, and rhiza tui app inbox --once prints what rhiza inbox --json prints

fields.acceptance: A test with fake operations and a fake exec drives each action and asserts the call it makes: o calls inbox.open with the item ID; an answer typed on a question calls session.message to its session with the typed text, and t sends the recommendation; y on a sign-off calls inbox.approve, c with text calls inbox.request-changes with it; R on a failed run calls rex window new running rhiza run resume <run>; x then y calls run.abandon, x then n calls nothing; no test runs real Rex or an agent
fields.statement: On the selected inbox item: enter or o focuses its Rex tab (inbox open); on a question, typing an answer and enter sends it to the asking session as a message (session message), or t takes the advisor's recommendation; on a sign-off, y approves it and c asks for changes with typed findings; on a failed, gave-up or skipped run, R retries it in a new Rex tab (rhiza run resume) and x abandons it after a y/n; each action reloads the list
